variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.sub: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has changed the colony's charter. A change to the governing framework deserves a precise account, not a guess at the powers affected. In considering {target}, readers should distinguish the fact of amendment from any particular new permission or restriction not specified in this report.

A charter amendment warrants attention, but it is not a sufficiently detailed basis for changing an operating assumption. Owners and managers should distinguish the known alteration of the framework from particular legal effects. Commercial judgment requires the relevant provision, rather than a general impression that the rules have changed.

We take a critical view of {target}. Altering the governing framework calls for exacting political responsibility, and the prestige of a charter supplies no automatic defence against questions about that responsibility. Reliable assessment begins with particulars rather than a politically convenient assumption.
